title: The underlying space of a scheme is sober
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Every irreducible closed subset $T\subseteq X$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] has a unique generic point: there is exactly one $\xi\in T$ with $\overline{\{\xi\}}=T$.
